declared: 2026-11-11, with configs/rubber/rubber_rl_tests_v1.json, committed alone and SHA-pinned (tests/test_rubber_rl_p6_0_declarations.py) before any P2-6 protocol run; a change is rubber_strip_drag_v2, never an edit

labels.resolution_measured_bias: rubber_ref_v1 (n_t 4) vs the n_t 4 / 6 / 8 extrapolation: Q1 +0.39 %, Q1w +0.62 %, Q2 -0.39 %, Q4 -0.05 % (refinement_v5_001; known_limitation rubber_phys_11_v5_q1w_gci_2.16pct, pending the K2 decision on ADR 0023 §23.2 decision 5)

recipe.build_material: recipe nominal (mu0 0.4 MPa, rho 1150, Prony (0.15, 10 ms), (0.10, 100 ms)) with friction_table = the midpoint of the friction range; every episode resamples (randomisation)

contact.friction_pad_and_self: fixed at the recipe values (1.0 / 0.9) and unused: no pad frame, no self-contact physics

traction_region.name: tip
traction_region.rule: particles with x in [L - 0.002, L] (every y, z)

scene.table_plane: z = 0 (normal +z), the strip's bottom face lies on it at reset
scene.grip: group 0 = the jaw nodes (reference x <= 0), Dirichlet, F8 projection, kick-average work; grip origin o = (0, W/2, t/2); a grip pose (p, q) maps the jaw by x = R(q) X + p - R(q) o

slot_selection: per env at build: explicit slot ids, or seeded: np.random.default_rng(slot_seed).integers(0, 9, N) indexes this list; a partial reset never changes a slot (UNSUPPORTED_GEOMETRY_CHANGE_ON_PARTIAL_RESET); rebuild() reselects

step_material.note: the randomisation maxima of c_p: dt 3.827 us, 5,226 substeps per 20 ms at dx 1 mm, CFL 0.5

randomisation.rng: per reset env: np.random.default_rng(seed) with the env's int64 reset seed; draws in this order, each a single uniform(lo, hi) float64
randomisation.material: mu0 = the INSTANTANEOUS shear modulus; kappa = 20 mu0; Prony terms = the recipe terms with every g_i x prony_g_scale and every tau_i x prony_tau_scale; friction_pad / friction_self = recipe values
randomisation.friction_rule: friction_table ~ U[0.3, min over the slot set's n_t of sliding_mu_max(v3, n_t)] of the envelope (ADR 0023 §23.2 decision 4); values above it or >= 1.0 are refused (UNSUPPORTED_FRICTION_OUT_OF_ENVELOPE)
randomisation.traction: constant tip traction for the whole episode (preload included): F = W_slot (h cos(phi), h sin(phi), v) with h, phi, v the traction draws and W_slot = rho n s^3 g (sampled density, n particles of the slot incl. the jaw, s = dx / 2, g = 9.81)
randomisation.friction_source: ENV1 / ENV2: contact_envelope_v2 (sha256 46f74efa) rows of law grid_node_penalty_coulomb_v3 at n_t 4 / 5 / 6 (contact_v3_001 for n_t 4; contact_envelope_v1_001 PASS for n_t 5 / 6 and the STRIP check at n_t 4): sliding_mu_max 0.8 each, so the range is [0.3, 0.8]

preload.rule: the first `steps` control steps of every episode follow a seeded smootherstep grip path; actions are ignored (info drive = PRELOAD, action_status 3), the reward is 0, the evaluator window excludes them
preload.path: after step k (1 <= k <= steps): tau = k / steps, s = 6 tau^5 - 15 tau^4 + 10 tau^3; p = o + (0, sweep_y s, lift s); q = rotation about +z by yaw s

goal.rule: tip goal on the table: (L + r cos(a), W/2 + r sin(a), t/2) with r = goal_radius_m, a = goal_angle_rad (the tip marker's reference is (L, W/2, t/2), so the initial tip distance is r >= 30 mm)

action.scale: a clipped to [-1, 1] (action_out_of_box if any |a_i| > 1); translation delta = 0.005 m x a[0:3]; rotation delta = axis-angle 0.05 rad x a[3:6] about the grip origin, world axes: q_new = exp(delta) q

workspace.rule: a policy step whose new pose leaves the box (offset p - o), lowers the jaw's lowest node (the jaw node bounding box under the new pose) below 1 mm above the table, or tilts the grip z axis by more than 0.8 rad from +z is held (pose unchanged, action_status 2, action_clamped True); it never terminates the episode. Preload poses are not clamped (they start at clearance 0 and end at lift_m)

action.tracking: ideal: the grip's END pose of the control step = the commanded pose, interpolated inside the step by the motion table (motion_table_v1)

policy.notes: markers: the 9 cross-section markers of rubber_strip_v1 (labelled ideal_marker_tracking); twist = the applied pose delta / control_dt (0 when held or before the first step); time_remaining = (max_episode_steps - step_count) / max_episode_steps; preload_flag = 1 while the next step is a preload step; no force, wrench, stress, J, energy, contact or material parameter

observation.non_finite: observation entries that are not finite (only after NONFINITE_STATE, with the terminal bit set) are returned as 0 (torch.nan_to_num(nan=0, posinf=0, neginf=0)); the state itself is not modified

reward.formula: r = -d / L - 0.01 ||a_clipped||^2 - 1.0 [termination_reason has an invalid-state bit], d = ||x_tip - x_goal||; a non-finite d (only after NONFINITE_STATE) contributes -1 (d / L := 1); r = 0 for preload steps; float64 on the device, returned as float32

done.terminated: (termination_reason & rl.termination.TERMINAL_BITS) != 0; every rubber invalid bit (NONFINITE 1, J_DOMAIN 2, CFL 4, SELF_CONTACT_UNRESOLVED 8) sets TERM_MATERIAL_INVALID (sticky); the detail is info['invalid_reason'] (privileged)

evaluator.success: step_count >= preload steps + 25, no terminal bit, and the tip within 0.010 m (3-D distance) of the goal after each of the last 25 control steps
evaluator.source: host evaluate() from device counters; success never comes from the reward

cpu_parity_v1.use: CPU parity / isolation / semantics tests only (RL-01 CPU, RL-02 a, RL-03 states, RL-04 L1, RL-05 CPU); every receipt carries test_configuration = cpu_parity_v1, never a formal throughput or physics row

rubber_rl_v1.use: labelled reduced-fidelity throughput rows of RL-07 only (plan §4.4): reduced_fidelity = thickness_resolution_n_t3 with the rubber_rl_v1 measured bias (rubber_material.RESOLUTION_PROFILES)
rubber_rl_v1.note: L 125 mm is not on the 2/3 mm particle lattice, so the variant uses the 100 / 150 mm slots; the friction range is unchanged (v3 envelope row n_t 3: 0.8)
